div.div: بَيْنَهُمَا شُبْكَةٌ , (K,) or شُبْكَةٌ نَسَب ٍ, (S, Msb,) (tropical:) Between them two is [a close or an intimate connexion of] relationship by birth: (S, K, TA:) and بَيْنَ القَوْمِ شُبْكَةُ نَسَب ٍ (tropical:) Between the people, or party, is an intermingling [of relationship]. (O, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
